newsitem.title: USA: Home Health to withdraw stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Home Health to withdraw stock offering.

text.p: Home Health Corp of America Inc said on Monday it intended to withdraw a registration statement filed with U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the sale of three million shares by the company and 623,500 shares by certain selling stockholders.

The company said it did not think the market price of its common stock adequately reflected Home Health's true value, and it was not in the best interest of shareholders to proceed with an offering at this time.

Bruce Feldman, chairman, president and chief executive officer, said: "We believe the company has the financial flexibility to withdraw the offering without affecting its operations or growth strategy."
